entries.note: First non-model entry: verified as gates + guards + ledger. The proofs come from the rig's own runner, so the evidence is SELF-ATTESTED — and now SAMPLED: a seeded random sample of 3 of its 12 guards was re-executed on 2026-10-26 (seed 20261026, 3/3 reproduced), by tools/sample-proofs.mjs in the SDK. The sample is published at harness-mesh/sampled-proofs.json. No m and no radius: inventing observables to fit the schema would be the fault this project exists to catch.
